name: agent-skill
summary: Ship the paired agent skill, embedded and self-installing
body:
SKILL.md teaches an agent the full loop: inspect, plan, check, apply,
verify, plus error recovery by stable code and the review-comment fix
loop. It ships inside the binary (include_str!) so `ism skill install`
always writes the skill matching this ism version — project scope by
default (.claude/skills/ism/), user scope with --user; `ism skill show`
prints it. Root copy stays byte-identical via scripts/check-sync.sh.
Design: D19/D20.
